qualifiers.reporting_period: calendar year ended December 31, 2025 unless a target year or base year is explicitly named
qualifiers.page_coordinates: one-based PDF page indexes; do not infer printed footer pages from section numbering

units.emissions: tCO2e; source literal tCO2eq is retained in evidence
units.water_intensity: m3 per million EUR of net sales on own operations

qualifiers.ghg_calculation: sum 2025 Scope 1, market-based Scope 2 and total Scope 3, then subtract the disclosed market-based total; do not substitute location-based Scope 2 or material Scope 3
qualifiers.target_direction: 2030 and 2050 target magnitudes are decreases from the 2019 base year; preserve signed 2025 progress literals separately
qualifiers.scope_3_target_boundary: purchased goods and services, upstream transportation and distribution, and business travel only
qualifiers.net_zero_boundary: the 2050 objective covers overall Scopes 1, 2 and 3 and offsets residual emissions to achieve net zero
qualifiers.water_boundary: water-risk consumption is calculated on the Group factory scope, defined in 2025
qualifiers.safety_boundary: recordable accident metrics exclude commuting lost days and first-aid accidents as stated by the issuer
qualifiers.slb_kpi_1b_boundary: cradle-to-shelf per product sold versus 2021; excludes Aēsop brand products; retain published and comparable performance separately
qualifiers.slb_kpi_2_boundary: primary, secondary and tertiary packaging; 50.14 percent is rounded down to the published 50 percent
qualifiers.slb_assurance_boundary: limited assurance covers the 2025 ESG KPIs; earlier periods and other information outside the ESG KPIs are excluded
qualifiers.statutory_assurance_boundary: limited assurance covers the 2025 sustainability information and Article 8 disclosures; the three conclusion objects remain separate
qualifiers.assurance_procedure_boundary: limited-assurance procedures are less extensive than reasonable-assurance procedures and do not assess management viability or quality choices for action plans, targets, policies, scenarios or transition plans
qualifiers.forward_looking_boundary: forward-looking information remains subject to inherent uncertainty and is not converted into an observed outcome
qualifiers.reference_type: simulated expert reference; not independent human gold
qualifiers.cloud_transmission: prohibited until the user authorizes the L'Oréal report, exact pages, qwen3.5:397b-cloud and P14 Stage A/Stage B single-attempt scope
